task: Implement a read-only runtime-owned agent asset resolution projection for Lattice CLI so projects can rely on local CLI-owned templates without copying prompt assets by default.
outcome: After completion, running the Lattice diagnostic smoke prints that runtime-owned agent asset projection passed, reports the prompt registry hash, classifies project-local .claude/.Codex prompt assets as absent/matches-runtime/stale/override, and states actual provider billing tokens are unavailable rather than claimed.
facts: B-bfb5 already reduced package prompt templates from 632,687 B to 115,317 B, about 129,343 approximate tokens saved at bytes/4.
prompt-registry.ts provides package-owned prompt registry hashes and host-specific rendering.
verify_codex already supports registry-backed thin mode without .Codex/agents when the manifest is present.
global-thin init currently writes .lattice/lattice.json assetMode=global-thin; the new plan says prompt-only thin config should not be required by default.
managed-assets can detect and apply managed asset drift, but this story must not add automatic repair/deletion/migration of project prompt assets.
constraints: Do not optimize for optimization or arbitrarily broaden scope.
Only fix real correctness issues: stale project prompt assets can shadow runtime-owned prompts and should be mechanically visible.
Follow consistency of logic across Claude CLI, Codex CLI, local Non-authority execution, and Authority Server boundaries.
Do not claim receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, or fullAuthorityDone without receipt-backed Authority Server proof.
Do not touch docs/story or tests/fixtures directly; all story evidence must go through Lattice CLI.
